title: Free module presheaf Čech complex is exact in positive degrees
statement: Let $(\mathcal C,\mathcal O)$ be a ringed site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], let $\mathcal U=\{U_i\to U\}_{i\in J}$ be a covering, and for each object $V$ let $\mathcal O_V$ be the free presheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules represented by $V$, namely $\mathcal O_V(W)=\bigoplus_{f:W\to V}\mathcal O(W)$. Put $K_p=\bigoplus_{(i_0,\ldots,i_p)\in J^{p+1}}\mathcal O_{U_{i_0}\times_U\cdots\times_UU_{i_p}}$ with alternating differential induced by the projections deleting one factor. Then $K_\bullet$ is exact in every positive degree in the category of presheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules.

source.place: Lemma Tag 03F5 (lemma-complex-tensored-still-exact), using the contracting-homotopy proof of Tag 03AT

proof.text: Fix an object W of the site. Exactness of a complex of presheaves of O-modules is checked objectwise, so it suffices to show H_p(K(W)) = 0 for p > 0. By the definition of O_V, K_p(W) is the free O(W)-module on pairs (i_0,...,i_p; psi), where psi is a morphism W -> U_i0 x_U ... x_U U_ip. The differential sends such a basis element to the alternating sum of the basis elements obtained by deleting one index and composing psi with the corresponding projection.

source.place: Lemma Tag 03AT, proof, first display; coefficients as in Lemma Tag 03F5

proof.text: For each morphism phi: W -> U let Mor_phi(W,U_i) be the set of lifts chi: W -> U_i whose composite to U is phi, and let S_phi be the disjoint union of these lift sets over i. The universal property of the fibre products gives a bijection between morphisms W -> U_i0 x_U ... x_U U_ip over phi and tuples of lifts in the corresponding Mor_phi sets. The projections delete tuple entries, so the basis set in degree p is the disjoint union over phi of S_phi^(p+1), compatibly with every face map.

source.place: Lemma Tag 03AT, proof: decomposition by phi and the sets of lifts

proof.text: Free modules on disjoint unions are direct sums, so the preceding identifications give an isomorphism of chain complexes K(W) = direct_sum over phi of C(S_phi; O(W)), where C_p(S;A) is the free A-module on (p+1)-tuples with the alternating deletion differential. Homology of a direct sum of complexes is the direct sum of the homologies.

source.place: Lemma Tag 03AT, proof; Lemma Tag 03F5, proof, first argument after tensoring with O(W)

proof.text: For p > 0 and each phi, if S_phi is empty then its summand is the zero complex. If S_phi is nonempty, the cited power-set complex lemma with A = O(W) gives H_p(C(S_phi; O(W))) = 0; its contracting homotopy inserts a chosen element of S_phi. Hence every summand has zero positive-degree homology, so H_p(K(W)) = 0 for all p > 0 and every W. Therefore K is exact in every positive degree as a presheaf complex.
